rules.title: Prohibited inquiries of rental applicants (unlawful practices)
rules.requirement: Owners, lessees, brokers, managing agents and others with the right to rent covered housing may not make or cause any written or oral inquiry or record about the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry or marital status of a person seeking to rent. The same applies to inquiries about veteran or armed forces status, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap.
rules.coverage_text: Owners, lessees, sublessees, licensed real estate brokers, assignees or managing agents of publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations, others with the right to rent or lease them, their agents or employees, and condominium or housing cooperative unit owner organizations.
rules.exemptions: The word 'age' does not apply to minors, to residency in state-aided or federally-aided housing developments for the elderly, to housing assisted under the federal low income housing tax credit intended for persons 55 or over or 62 or over, or to communities built expressly for persons 55 or over or 62 or over if the owner or manager registers biennially with the executive office of housing and livable communities.
rules.quoted_span: (c) to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry or marital status of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation, or concerning the fact that such person is a veteran or a member of the armed forces or because such person is blind or hearing impaired or has any other handicap.
